## File: huggingface_transformers/tests/repo_utils/test_check_docstrings.py

Prompts

```
['test the replace_default_in_arg_description function that updates default values in docstring argument descriptions', 'build AST indexes for decorated classes and functions, extracting __init__ arguments and custom_args text', 'test the get_default_description function that generates docstring default descriptions from inspect.Parameter objects', 'find TypedDict subclasses in source code, extracting public field names while skipping private fields and known kwargs', 'test the _get_auto_docstring_names function that detects classes and functions decorated with @auto_docstring in a Python file', 'infer tests to run by analyzing git diff and building reverse dependency maps of modified files', 'create a reverse dependency map that identifies all modules and tests impacted by changes to a given source file', 'get the module dependencies of a Python file by parsing its imports and resolving relative and absolute paths', 'extract imports from a Python file and resolve them to their actual source file paths with imported names', 'clean Python source code by removing docstrings, comments, and empty lines to detect real vs docstring-only diffs']
```

Usage

```
{'test_replace_default_in_arg_description': 'test the replace_default_in_arg_description function that updates default values in docstring argument descriptions', 'build_ast_indexes_decorated': 'build AST indexes for decorated classes and functions, extracting __init__ arguments and custom_args text', 'test_get_default_description': 'test the get_default_description function that generates docstring default descriptions from inspect.Parameter objects', 'find_typed_dict_classes': 'find TypedDict subclasses in source code, extracting public field names while skipping private fields and known kwargs', 'test_get_auto_docstring_names': 'test the _get_auto_docstring_names function that detects classes and functions decorated with @auto_docstring in a Python file'}
```
